subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets after the browser Canvas action endpoint exists, or should this remain outside bundled dashboard work?
rationale: The request crosses product direction and security boundaries: it depends on an unmerged dashboard host and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions through trusted Gateway/dashboard paths.

options.title: Design After Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open, make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 the prerequisite action-ingress contract, then design the dashboard adapter against that approved shape.

options.title: Bundle With Dashboard Host
options.body: Accept this as part of the bundled modular-dashboard stack once the custom-widget host has a maintainer-approved landing path and security proof.

options.title: Route Outward
options.body: If bundled dashboard expansion is not current product work, ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package after the needed APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Design After Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 the prerequisite action-ingress contract, then design the dashboard adapter against that approved shape.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest current-main Control UI plugin-tab precedent and related web-widget product direction signal available in the inspected history.
